Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency/throughput numbers. Procurement asked me to follow up with a few items so we can finalize commercials:

1) Platform fee amortization — Orbitec prefers to amortize the platform fee across 24 months for capex planning. Can Redwood provide an amortization schedule (12 vs 24 months) and confirm there are no hidden recurring charges beyond the platform fee + node credits + support retainer?

2) Operator / site licenses — we need to understand per-site operator licensing vs per-node. Our target is 3 sites, initially 8 GPU nodes total (pilot), expanding to 24 nodes in year 2. What does a migration to multi-site look like from a licensing and invoicing perspective?

3) SRE retainer — we need 24/7 escalation coverage. Please confirm the support tiers and whether the Enhanced SRE retainer can be scoped as a fixed monthly retainer rather than T&M. If fixed, can you provide sample SLAs and on-call rotation model?

4) Invoice cadence & PO requirements — procurement prefers monthly invoices tied to usage floor and a quarterly true-up. Is that supported?

If possible, can you send a short commercial summary + a draft SOW we can circulate with procurement/legal?

Appreciate it — Evan
Evan Li

- Yes, we can provide both 12- and 24-month amortization schedules for the platform fee; we'll include line-items for node credits and the optional SRE retainer so you can see the delta.

Evan / team — attached is the pricing workbook (proposed_pricing_breakdown_20270618.xlsx) and a short summary below. High level assumptions: 3 sites, pilot = 8 GPU nodes (NVIDIA H100 equiv), growth to 24 nodes in month 13. All currency USD.

Pilot (months 1-6) — recommended path for quick go-live:
- Platform fee (one-time upfront) = $240,000 amortized; amortization options: 12-mo = $20,000/mo, 24-mo = $10,000/mo.
- Node credits = $1,600 per GPU-node/month (pilot pricing), so 8 nodes = $12,800/mo.
- Operator / site license = $6,000 per site (one-time) x 3 = $18,000.
- Enhanced SRE retainer option (fixed monthly) = $18,000/mo (named SRE coverage, runbook + 24/7 rotation, 4hr P1).

Scale (months 13+) — volume adjustments:
- Node credit volume price for >=24 nodes = $1,250 per node/mo (after volume discount).
- We can apply a 10% credit against the remaining platform fee if Orbitec commits to a 24-month firm commit at signature.

Examples (illustrative monthly cash flow):
- 12-mo amortization & Enhanced SRE: platform $20,000 + nodes $12,800 + SRE $18,000 = $50,800/mo (pilot).
- 24-mo amortization & Standard support: platform $10,000 + nodes $12,800 + support $6,000 = $28,800/mo (pilot).

Notes / trade-offs to surface:
- Amortizing platform fee over 24 months reduces near-term cash but delays full revenue recognition – if Orbitec needs a 24-mo capex model we can do that; for internal Redwood accounting we treat it as deferred revenue and will require the SOW to state the schedule.
- Operator licenses are one-time per site; they include operator tooling and admin seats for on-site management.
- Enhanced SRE retainer includes 40hrs/mo of proactive ops time + unlimited P1 incident handling up to SLA; additional T&M beyond included runtime is billed at our published rates (we’ll call these out in the SOW).

I'll attach the workbook with line-by-line amortization schedules for 12/24 months and a sample invoice cadence (monthly with quarterly true-up). Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
